name: Amplify
description: +50% output (flat, applied where it sits in the chain).

name: Split
description: x3 copies, each -35% output.

name: Echo
description: Repeats everything before it once, 0.2s later, at 70% output.

name: Accelerate
description: -30% trigger interval. The row fires more often.

name: Enlarge
description: +60% area. Affects bursts, fields, mines and shoves - not projectiles.

name: Pierce
description: Projectiles pass through 2 more enemies. Only affects projectiles.

name: Ricochet
description: Projectiles bounce once to a new target. Only affects projectiles.

name: Focus
description: Fires once instead of many, each shot far harder. Before a Split the two multiply; after one, it cancels it.

name: Sustain
description: +80% duration. Affects anything that lingers: fields, mines, orbitals, buffs.

name: Leech
description: 3% of damage dealt returns to you as Integrity.

name: Volatile
description: Effects detonate at the end of their life for 50% output.

name: Quantize
description: Locks this row to the engine pulse. Fires landing on the beat hit 25% harder.

name: Overdrive
description: +100% output, and every fire adds Heat directly. The Cycles it costs are the price of skipping the budget.

name: Resonate
description: This row also fires whenever the row directly above it fires.

name: Ground
description: The row above reserves 30% fewer Cycles. This row outputs 20% less.

name: Fork
description: +2 chain jumps, -20% output. Arc had no modifier of its own until this one.

name: Conduct
description: +80% range: shots fly further, beams and chains stretch. Range as a row decision.

name: Seeker
description: Projectiles steer toward what they were aimed at, and fly 25% slower for it.

name: Slug
description: Half speed, +90% output. A shot that takes its time and lands like a wall.

name: Bloom
description: Area effects detonate a second time, smaller, right after the first. Bursts, fields, mines, shoves.

name: Insulate
description: This row makes no Heat at all, and pays 25% of its output for it. The cold half of a hot build.

name: Grounding Rod
description: Events from this row start a fresh cascade at depth 0 — no depth falloff, no Heat from how deep it was.

name: Stagger
description: Everything this row does lands 0.35s late. Pairs with Resonate: the row above fires, this one answers.

name: Mirror
description: This row uses the Action of the row above it, whatever that becomes. Its own Action is ignored.

name: Governor
description: Half the Cycles, and this row's output is capped at 2x its base. How a full Engine finds room for one more.
